verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services such as venture capital, IP and data protection work. It is not a software platform that exposes an API, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a category error. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any programmatic API product that would make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
